Standings of an ssgt (gameday widget)

Source: R/shl.R
shl_standings.Rd

Wraps GET https://www.shl.se/api/gameday/team-standings/{ssgt_uuid} of the SHL site API (www.shl.se). Unofficial use of a public source; seasons are END years (2026 = 2025/26) and are mapped to the site's ssgt uuids through /statistics-v2/layout-info.

Usage

shl_standings(ssgt_uuid, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

ssgt_uuid

ssgt uuid: one season + series + game type (e.g. 2025/2026 SHL regular season). Directory: /statistics-v2/layout-info seasonSeriesGameTypeTeams[].ssgtUuid.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw decoded JSON as a list.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (the raw JSON list when return_parsed = FALSE) with the following columns:

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025/26).
ssgt_uuidcharacterssgt uuid (platform key space: one season + series + game type); label via layout-info seasonSeriesGameTypeTeams[].
team_codecharacterStatNet team code (SAIK, FHC).
team_uuidcharacterPlatform team uuid.
team_namecharacterName of the team.
team_short_namecharacterShort display name of the team.
rankintegerPosition in the table (1 = top).
rank_diffintegerChange in standings rank, in places (the reference point is unverified).
gpintegerNumber of games played.
wintegerRegulation wins.
tintegerGames tied after regulation, decided in overtime or a shootout (= OTW + OTL).
lintegerRegulation losses.
otwintegerOvertime and shootout wins.
otlintegerOvertime and shootout losses.
pintegerStandings points (3 per regulation win, 2 per OT/SO win, 1 per OT/SO loss).
gfintegerNumber of goals scored (goals for).
gaintegerNumber of goals conceded (goals against).
diffintegerGoal difference.

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: the host answered 404, an empty body (gameday routes before 2023/24), a table with no rows, or the season and game type are not in layout-info. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx answer or a dead connection after retries, a non-JSON or error-envelope 200, a stats-info page that reaches count or falls short of its totalCount, or a body for another game, team, athlete or ssgt than the one asked for. fastRhockey_bad_request: a 400 / 422, a season that is not a year, or an argument outside its choices.
